product_one_liner.value: Together AI provides an AI cloud for developers and businesses to run, fine-tune, and deploy open-source AI models using inference APIs and GPU infrastructure.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage and documentation describe its full-stack AI platform and services for inference, post-training, fine-tuning, and GPU clusters.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing is listed for inference and other platform services.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in Together AI customer stories.

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists a size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Francisco, California as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2022 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple substantive engineering and research posts, including work on GPU kernels and continual AI inference compilation, rather than only marketing or release notes.

public_docs.notes: Together AI has a public documentation site with multiple product and API documentation sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board includes an AI Infrastructure System Engineer position.

model_provider.value: Third-party model families including DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral are hosted on Together AI's infrastructure; Together also documents passthrough models that use an upstream provider.
model_provider.notes: The privacy documentation names third-party model authors and distinguishes hosted models from passthrough models.

compliance_certs.notes: Together AI publicly states that it completed a SOC 2 Type 2 examination and earned ISO 27001:2022 certification.

last_funding.notes: The company announced an $800 million Series C on July 1, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 Series C was within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board was readable and did not list SDR, BDR, Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative, or Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Together AI announced Together Compiler on November 4, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found no verifiable C-level or VP-level join/departure within the window, but could not verify a sufficiently complete current leadership roster to support a negative answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Public integrations documentation and the job board were readable, but I found no publicly named CRM or sales/marketing system used by Together AI.
